summary_en: JG44 amended its tender offer terms for HYUGA PRIMARY CARE following receipt of clearance notices from the Fair Trade Commission on October 7, 2026. The amendment to the October 28 offer announcement reflects FTC approval to proceed without exclusionary measures and a shortened prohibition period, though purchase conditions remain materially unchanged.
title_en: Notice on Correction of Tender Offer Commencement Announcement Accompanying Submission of Amended Tender Offer Filing by JG44 Inc.
translation_en_brief: JG44 Inc. submitted an amended tender offer filing on October 14, 2026 for HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd. shares listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market. The amendment was necessitated by FTC clearance notices received on October 7, 2026: a notification that no exclusionary measures would be imposed and a notification of shortened prohibition period. While the announcement of commencement was revised to reflect these FTC determinations, the substantive purchase conditions and other material terms of the tender offer remain unchanged. The original tender offer commenced on September 28, 2026.
